mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Products ( category, subCategory, product_Name, price, reg_Date, product_Desc, product_main_img, product_size_img, discount_rate, is_recommended ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{subCategory}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{regDate}, #{productDesc}, #{productMainImg}, #{productSizeImg}, #{discountRate}, #{isRecommended} )
INSERT INTO ProductOption ( product_Idx, color, size, stock ) VALUES ( #{productIdx}, #{color}, #{size}, #{stock} )
mapper.select: SELECT option_Idx AS optionIdx, product_Idx AS productIdx, color, size, stock FROM ProductOption WHERE product_Idx = #{productIdx}

SELECT * FROM Products
order by product_Idx desc limit #{startIdx}, #{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM Products WHERE product_idx = #{productIdx}
SELECT * FROM ProductImg WHERE product_idx = #{value}
SELECT * FROM ProductDescImg WHERE product_idx = #{value}
SELECT * FROM ProductOption WHERE product_idx = #{value}
SELECT * FROM ProductImg WHERE product_Img_Idx = #{value}
SELECT * FROM ProductDescImg WHERE product_Desc_Img_Idx = #{value}
select count(*) as imgCount from ProductImg WHERE product_idx = #{value}
select count(*) as descImgCount from ProductDescImg WHERE product_idx = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE Products SET category=#{category}, subCategory=#{subCategory}, product_Name=#{productName}, price=#{price}, product_Desc=#{productDesc}, product_main_Img=#{productMainImg}, product_size_Img=#{productSizeImg}, discount_rate=#{discountRate}, is_Recommended=#{isRecommended} WHERE product_Idx = #{productIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_Idx, p.category, p.subCategory, p.product_Name, p.price, p.reg_Date, p.product_Desc, p.discount_rate, p.is_Recommended FROM Products p ORDER BY p.reg_Date DESC
select count(*) as totalCount from Products
SELECT option_Idx AS optionIdx, product_Idx AS productIdx, color, size, stock FROM ProductOption WHERE option_Idx = #{optionIdx}

SELECT p.product_Idx, p.category, p.subCategory, p.product_Name, p.price, p.reg_Date, p.product_Desc, p.discount_rate, p.is_Recommended, mainImg.product_Img AS pMainImgPath, sizeImg.product_Img AS pSizeImgPath FROM Products p LEFT JOIN ProductImg mainImg ON p.product_Idx = mainImg.product_Idx AND mainImg.product_Img_Order = 1 LEFT JOIN ProductImg sizeImg ON p.product_Idx = sizeImg.product_Idx AND sizeImg.product_Img_Order = 2 ORDER BY p.reg_Date DESC

SELECT p.product_Idx, p.category, p.subCategory, p.product_Name, p.price, p.reg_Date, p.product_Desc, p.discount_Rate, p.is_Recommended, mainImg.product_Img AS productMainImg, sizeImg.product_Img AS productSizeImg FROM Products p LEFT JOIN ProductImg mainImg ON p.product_Idx = mainImg.product_Idx AND mainImg.product_Img_Order = 1 LEFT JOIN ProductImg sizeImg ON p.product_Idx = sizeImg.product_Idx AND sizeImg.product_Img_Order = 2 WHERE p.product_Idx = #{productIdx}
SELECT r.review_Idx, r.product_Idx, r.user_Idx, r.user_Name, r.review, r.Rating, r.is_Hide, r.reg_Date FROM Reviews r WHERE r.product_Idx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY r.reg_Date DESC

SELECT product_idx AS productIdx, product_name AS productName, price, product_main_img AS productMainImg, discount_rate AS discountRate, is_recommended AS isRecommended FROM Products WHERE is_recommended = 1 ORDER BY product_idx DESC

SELECT p.product_idx AS productIdx, p.product_name AS productName, p.category AS category, p.price, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating)), 0) as avgRating, COUNT(r.product_Idx) as reviewCount FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Reviews r ON p.product_Idx = r.product_Idx WHERE p.discount_rate > 0 GROUP BY p.product_idx, p.product_name, p.category, p.price, p.product_main_img, p.discount_rate ORDER BY p.product_idx DESC

SELECT p.product_Idx AS productIdx, p.category AS category, p.subCategory AS subCategory, p.product_Name AS productName, p.price AS price, p.reg_Date AS regDate, p.product_Desc AS productDesc, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, p.is_Recommended AS isRecommended, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating)),0) as avgRating, COUNT(r.product_Idx) as reviewCount FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Reviews r ON p.product_Idx = r.product_Idx WHERE p.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.subCategory LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_Name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY p.product_Idx, p.category, p.subCategory, p.product_Name, p.price, p.reg_Date, p.product_Desc, p.product_main_img, p.discount_rate, p.is_Recommended ORDER BY p.reg_Date DESC
